Name: It puts the Mayo on its skin.
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
[b]It Rubs The Mayo In[/b] lets you throw Mayonnaise and Books into the Farm Well for strange, ridiculous dialogue.

Toss in a mayo, get a quote. Then toss in a Book to keep the cycle going. 

The mod alternates between Mayonnaise and Books, cycling through each set of lines in a random order before reshuffling.

Supports:
[list]
[*]Mayonnaise [/*]
[*]Duck Mayonnaise [/*]
[*]Void Mayonnaise [/*]
[*]Dinosaur Mayonnaise [/*]
[*]Power Books[/*]
[*]Skill Books[/*]
[/list]After enough Mayo has been sacrificed to the Well, there is also a rare special line that can appear.

I always end up with a ton of extra books. Now you have something to do with them.

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
